subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. 'ensure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Conserving trees and planting more are actions aimed **to secure the environment's future, captured by 'ensure'.**
 
• '**Ensure**' is contextually appropriate as it means** to make certain, relating directly to the goal of preserving life forms on Earth**.
 
• The use of 'ensure' underlines the proactive approach to safeguard the atmosphere and life through conservation.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'ensure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'Refuse'** means to decline to do or accept something.
 
• **'Pretend' **implies to make believe with the intent to deceive.
 
• **'Rebuke'** means to express sharp disapproval or criticism.

Complete Passage is: Trees are one of the gifts of the nature which are of great importance__ for all living beings and environment. They have __ample__ benefits to living beings providing natural herbs, vegetables, fruits, wood, timber, etc. Trees are the __abode__ of many birds and insects. They are also considered as the __integral__ part of the atmosphere which help in reducing pollution. Conserving trees and spreading awareness to plant trees will save the atmosphere from depletion and __ensure__ survival of all forms on earth.
